Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3941|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff3066|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2453|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff6914|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff209|r Magicka and |cffffff374|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1000|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff11409|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5185|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.
1.name: Magical Trample

2.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1912|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8730|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
2.name: Rending Slashes

3.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1121|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Quick Cloak

4.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff955|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.
4.name: Gripping Shards

5.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8884|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9609|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.
5.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%

30.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
30.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

31.name: Resolve
31.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

32.name: Constitution
32.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

33.name: Juggernaut
33.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

34.name: Revitalize
34.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

35.name: Rapid Mending
35.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

36.name: Hand Brush
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF2|r.

37.name: Augur
37.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Only works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest three layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

38.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
38.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

39.name: Improved Hiding
39.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff10|r%.

40.name: Light Fingers
40.description: Increases your chance of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff20|r%.

41.name: Trafficker
41.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff120|r%.

42.name: Locksmith
42.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff10|r%.

43.name: Kickback
43.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff10|r%.

44.name: Scry
44.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

45.name: Antiquarian Insight
45.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Simple difficulty.

46.name: Soul Summons
46.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

47.name: Soul Shatter
47.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff3367|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

48.name: Soul Lock
48.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

49.name: Blade of Woe
49.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

50.name: Intimidating Presence
50.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

51.name: Banish the Wicked
51.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

52.name: Skilled Tracker
52.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

53.name: Bounty Hunter
53.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

54.name: Persuasive Will
54.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

55.name: See the Unseen
55.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

56.name: Finders Keepers
56.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

57.name: Swiftly Forgotten
57.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

58.name: Haggling
58.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

59.name: Clemency
59.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

60.name: Timely Escape
60.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

61.name: Veil of Shadows
61.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

62.name: Undaunted Command
62.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1226|r Health, |cffffff997|r Stamina, and |cffffff558|r Magicka.

63.name: Undaunted Mettle
63.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

64.name: Continuous Attack
64.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

65.name: Magicka Aid
65.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

66.name: Combat Medic
66.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

67.name: Battle Resurrection
67.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

68.name: Cutpurse
68.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Medium Armor skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your chance to successfully pickpocket by |cffffff5|r%.

69.name: Robustness
69.description: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff90|r.

70.name: Lunar Blessings
70.description: Increase your Maximum Health, Magicka, and Stamina by |cffffff915|r.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3941|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff3066|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2453|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff6914|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff209|r Magicka and |cffffff374|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1000|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff11409|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5185|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.
1.name: Magical Trample

2.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1912|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8730|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
2.name: Rending Slashes

3.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1121|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Quick Cloak

4.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff955|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.
4.name: Gripping Shards

5.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8884|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9609|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.
5.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker

2.name: Savage Beast

3.name: Flourish

9.name: Glacial Presence
9.description: Increases your chance to apply the Chilled status effect by |cffffff250|r% and increases its damage by |cffffff304|r. The damage increasing effect scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

10.name: Frozen Armor
10.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1240|r for each Winter's Embrace ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1240|r.

11.name: Icy Aura
11.description: When you take direct damage from an enemy in melee range, you apply a stack of Bite of Winter to them for |cffffff3|r seconds, up to |cffffff5|r stacks max. Attackers at max stacks are afflicted with Major Maim for |cffffff3|r seconds, reducing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Piercing Cold
12.description: Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff8|r% and increases your Frost Damage by |cffffff15|r%.

The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

44.name: Scry
44.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

45.name: Antiquarian Insight
45.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Simple difficulty.

46.name: Soul Summons
46.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

47.name: Soul Shatter
47.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff3690|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

48.name: Soul Lock
48.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

49.name: Blade of Woe
49.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

50.name: Intimidating Presence
50.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

51.name: Banish the Wicked
51.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

52.name: Skilled Tracker
52.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

53.name: Bounty Hunter
53.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

54.name: Persuasive Will
54.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

55.name: See the Unseen
55.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

56.name: Finders Keepers
56.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

57.name: Swiftly Forgotten
57.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

58.name: Haggling
58.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

59.name: Clemency
59.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

60.name: Timely Escape
60.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

61.name: Veil of Shadows
61.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

62.name: Undaunted Command
62.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1344|r Health, |cffffff997|r Stamina, and |cffffff558|r Magicka.

63.name: Undaunted Mettle
63.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

64.name: Continuous Attack
64.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

65.name: Magicka Aid
65.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

66.name: Combat Medic
66.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

67.name: Battle Resurrection
67.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

68.name: Cutpurse
68.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Medium Armor skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your chance to successfully pickpocket by |cffffff5|r%.

69.name: Robustness
69.description: Increases your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff90|r.

70.name: Lunar Blessings
70.description: Increase your Maximum Health, Magicka, and Stamina by |cffffff915|r.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3941|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff3361|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2689|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff7580|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff209|r Magicka and |cffffff374|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1000|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff12506|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5684|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.
1.name: Magical Trample

2.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1912|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8730|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
2.name: Rending Slashes

3.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1121|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Quick Cloak

4.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff1045|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.
4.name: Gripping Shards

5.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8884|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9609|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.
5.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker

2.name: Savage Beast

Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

9.name: Glacial Presence

10.name: Frozen Armor
10.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1240|r for each Winter's Embrace ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1240|r.

11.name: Icy Aura
11.description: When you take direct damage from an enemy in melee range, you apply a stack of Bite of Winter to them for |cffffff3|r seconds, up to |cffffff5|r stacks max. Attackers at max stacks are afflicted with Major Maim for |cffffff3|r seconds, reducing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Piercing Cold
12.description: Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff8|r% and increases your Frost Damage by |cffffff15|r%.

The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

2.name: Heavy Weapons

Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped:

Axes increase your Critical Damage done by |cffffff12|r%.

Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff2974|r.

3.name: Balanced Blade

5.name: Battle Rush

7.name: Sword and Board

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff3941|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff3361|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2689|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff7580|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff209|r Magicka and |cffffff374|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1000|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff12506|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5684|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.
1.name: Magical Trample

2.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1912|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8730|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
2.name: Rending Slashes

3.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1121|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Quick Cloak

4.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff1045|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.
4.name: Gripping Shards

5.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8884|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9609|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.
5.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker

You are concealed from enemy sight, as long as you remain undetected. While Sneaking, your next Direct Damage attack will Critically Strike and gain bonus effects depending on the attack type, as long the target isn't facing you.

- Melee Attacks stun the first enemy hit for |cffffff2|r seconds and gain maximum Critical Damage against monsters.
- Ranged Attacks gain |cffffff50|r% Critical Damage against monsters.

5.name: Minor Toughness
